text:
alina: Quick design review — compact rollout list feels cramped when you add allocation badges. wondering if we should de-emphasize percentage labels?

matt: Agreed it's noisy. Current row has: Version chip | timeline sparkline | 3 allocation badges | timestamp | rollback btn. Too much.

rita: What if we collapse allocations into a single pill with hover to expand? e.g. "20% · 50% · 30%" -> "Allocations: 3" and showing full list on focus/hover. helps on mobile.

sam: +1 for collapse, but keyboard users need the expanded info available without hover. expand on focus + aria-controls to toggle a region.

noah: Also contrast issue: allocation badges use pale blue on light grey, fails 4.5:1 at small sizes. Either darker bg or introduce bold text.

alina: Good catch. Proposal: make collapsed pill #0f62fe text on white (accessible) and add an outline variant for secondary. rita, can you mock two density options: compact (1 line) and relaxed (2 lines)?

rita: Mocked both — uploaded images in the thread. compact keeps allocation pill, relaxed splits timestamp to a second line which buys 12px. compact variant has sub-issues: tooltip overlap with timeline scrubber.

matt: About the timeline scrubber: when you hover the row the scrubber shows play controls — that currently steals pointer events from the allocation pill. We should z-index scrubber below interactive chips.

sam: For a11y, we need to ensure the scrubber is reachable by keyboard in the same order as other controls. Suggest tabindex order: version chip -> allocation pill -> scrubber -> rollback.

noah: Copy nit: rollback button label currently "Rollback" — could be clearer like "Rollback to this version" or "Revert version"? short but explicit for screenreader.

alina: I prefer "Revert to this version" (verb-first for action clarity). Also we need confirmation modal copy: "Are you sure? This will route traffic away from the current release." add a link to 'rollback docs'.

sam: Modal should announce role=dialog and include aria-describedby pointing to the explanatory copy. Add focus trap and initial focus on primary "Revert" only after user tabs through the explanation.

rita: Also noticed timeline timestamps are visual-only. For VO we should expose an accessible label like "deployed 3 days ago, 14:22 UTC" on the version chip.

matt: Performance note: collapsing allocations will reduce DOM nodes by ~30% on big deployments, helpful for large org views.

alina: OK action items: rita — provide compact/relaxed mocks + hover/focus states, matt — adjust z-index and tab order in prototype, sam — write a11y spec snippets (aria attributes + dialog behavior), noah — propose color tokens that meet contrast. I'll update the console tickets.

ux-bot: Reminder: design sign-off required before next sprint. Add checklist: mocks, a11y spec, copy, QA test plan. :white_check_mark:

sam: One more: keyboard-only users should be able to reveal allocation breakdown with Enter when focused on the pill. Make the pill a button element.

rita: noted. I'll include button state and example CSS: 
``` 
.pill { padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 12px; background: #eaf2ff; color: #003366; }
.pill:focus { outline: 3px solid #80b3ff; }
```

alina: Thanks all — target mock review on Monday. If anyone has quick wins (contrast token or copy tweak) drop them here and I'll fold into the ticket.
